dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: A long, long time later, there will definitely be new Nara friends coming to Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: But the future Nara will not have to go to the Ashvattha to look for the melodies of today.

dialogues.speaker: Arakavi
dialogues.text: Because all Aranara and the leaves and soil of Vana will remember this Festival Utsava, remember the golden song.
